scope: 47 reviewed source families: 34 contextual constructed-graph detections, 6 supplied-file-context detections, 5 opaque payload boundaries, 1 consumer behaviour and 1 source approval review. Not a universal ISO/WTPDF validator.
exceptions: Info.CreationDate and Info.ModDate are not deprecated; thread information does not become document Info.
Only contextual Type1 CharSet and CID-font CIDSet declarations are checked, not arbitrary fields with those spellings.
Image-mask OPI and redefinitions of the standard Identity crypt-filter name are ignored.
Halftone transfer functions are distinct from deprecated graphics-state TR/TR2.
Private action-trigger names and form/private ID values are not assigned unrelated standard semantics.
PrintField.Checked is current; lowercase checked in an explicit PrintField owner is deprecated.
Crypt-filter Length remains required by the same source table that labels it deprecated.
WTPDF8.9.1 and8.10.1 SHALL prohibitions remain separate existing failures.
remaining_boundaries: Absent application-supplied trailer context leaves document Info and encryption declarations uninspected.
Opaque content, CMaps, CMS signatures, public-key recipients and untyped FDF payloads require independent format or cryptographic parsing.
Custom-owner/namespaced attribute semantics and processor behaviour require human or external validation.
EC3 issue133 source/approval and semantic applicability are not resolved by catalogue registration.
The API inspects constructed objects and supplied context; it does not authenticate imported PDF bytes or reconstruct historical revisions.
